about_short_description.short_description: Float Health is a digital advertising agency for healthcare and pharmaceuticals.

product.name: Medical Consulting
product.description: Provides expert advice and strategic guidance on medical and healthcare-related projects for pharmaceutical and healthcare clients.

product.name: Medical Content
product.description: Development of scientifically accurate medical and healthcare content for various communication channels and audiences.

product.name: Advertising
product.description: Creation and execution of advertising campaigns targeting healthcare and pharmaceutical audiences across multiple media channels.

product.name: Digital Health Strategy
product.description: Development of strategic plans for digital health initiatives, integrating technology and data to support healthcare communication and engagement.

product.name: Public Relations & Public Affairs
product.description: Communication consulting focused on media relations, strategic messaging, and stakeholder engagement for healthcare brands and organizations.

product.name: Medical Events
product.description: Planning and management of healthcare-related events, including in-person and virtual formats, targeting diverse healthcare audiences.
